checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Spoken words match the script exactly, no intro or extra words
must.why: The final WAV was not provided. The images are only voice-list preview portraits. The assistant says it used the exact script.

must.item: One voice reads the whole script, calm and reassuring
must.why: Grace was picked without being heard, and the delivery cannot be judged from the material given.

must.item: Recording lasts about 10 seconds, not rushed or cut off
must.why: The assistant did not measure the length and says it may be a little short. The 5 s and 2 s clips are voice previews, not the deliverable.

must.item: Only speech is audible, with no music or sound effects
must.why: The final file was not analysed. The assistant claims speech only, and TTS usually gives that.

must.item: Deliverable is a standalone playable audio file
must.why: The assistant reports a WAV download link and no video or text-only script. The file itself was not checked.

exact_text.text: Take a slow breath. Let your shoulders relax. There is nothing you need to rush right now.
exact_text.read_as: No text appears in the images. They are a woman's portrait and a man's portrait, which are voice-list previews.

faults.what: The voice was chosen without listening to it, so the calm, reassuring tone is unverified.
The duration was not measured. It may fall noticeably short of 10 seconds, even at 0.85× speed.
The images show only voice-list preview portraits, not the delivered audio, so the output cannot be verified.

summary: The agent delivered a WAV link for a TTS read of the exact script with the female voice Grace at 0.85× speed, but the voice, the length and the speech-only claim are unverified. The images shown are only voice-list preview portraits.
